confidence_formula: C = 50 × (native ipTM + max(ipSAE binder→target, ipSAE target→binder))
physics_status: Results pending scientific scalar review; no physics values included in this snapshot.

ranking_policy.blue_overall: 0.5 × mean(C across five states) + 0.5 × min(C across five states); all five required
ranking_policy.red: Within each engine, freeze the panel of contestants with WT C ≥ 50 after all 23 WT scores exist. Count a provisional escape signal when ipTM and both directional ipSAE each drop by at least max(0.10, 25% of WT value). Rank 100 × signals / fixed panel size only with complete panel coverage. WT and P33S remain unranked references.
ranking_policy.interpretation: Uncalibrated confidence-loss heuristic, not established binding or biological escape. No target-integrity or physics confirmation is implied. C ≥ 50 is a provisional eligibility threshold, not a validated binding cutoff.
ranking_policy.ties: Competition ranks on scores rounded to six decimals
ranking_policy.physics: Confidence now uses maximum directional ipSAE. Combined weights and joint confidence-plus-physics escape criterion are unchanged; pending physics is never imputed.
ranking_policy.blue_retention: Number of states meeting BOTH engine-specific native ipTM and maximum directional ipSAE cutoffs, out of five (including WT and P33S). All five evaluations required for a rank; missing is unknown. Equal counts share ranks; confidence does not break ties.
ranking_policy.confidence_revision: Maximum replaces minimum directional ipSAE for all derived confidence scores. The approved roster is unchanged. The Red WT C ≥ 50 eligibility panel is recomputed with this definition; its three-metric decline rule is unchanged.

retention_policy.rule: Both metrics must meet or exceed their cutoff. Count each of WT, R27P, S30del, P34del and P33S once.
retention_policy.method: For each metric and engine: floor(100 × 0.90 × min(B5 WT, L10 WT)) / 100. Freeze these cutoffs; do not refit to incoming pairs.
retention_policy.interpretation: Provisional control-relative confidence screen, not a calibrated binding classifier. No labeled nonbinder set is available here to estimate specificity. The 90% allowance and rounding are policy choices, not an experimentally learned boundary. A failed cutoff is below-screen confidence, not proof of nonbinding. Retention is not the complement of the Red escape rule.
retention_policy.sensitivity_note: 85%, 90%, and 95% of the same WT-control anchors. Counts use available pairs; unknown pairs stay unknown. This is threshold sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.
